name: doc2skill
headline: doc2skill - Convert Docs to Claude Skills
short_description: Converts any documentation website into a Claude AI skill. Ideal for operations teams to automate knowledge extraction and integration. Connects to Claude AI, enabling quick access to documentation without manual input.
author: moinulmoin

sections.overview:
Skill Seeker automates the transformation of any documentation website into a production-ready Claude AI skill. The tool scrapes documentation, organizes content by topic, enhances it with AI-extracted examples and key concepts, and packages everything into an uploadable .zip file for Claude. It includes 8 ready-to-use presets for frameworks like React, Vue, Django, and Godot, plus a universal scraper that works with any documentation site. Operations teams, developers, and organizations can build comprehensive reference skills in 20-40 minutes instead of hours of manual work, with no API costs for local enhancement.
Create Claude skills for popular frameworks (React, Vue, Django, FastAPI) from official documentation
Build internal documentation skills for company APIs and proprietary tools
Generate game engine reference skills (Godot, Unity) for game developers
Establish comprehensive learning reference skills for technologies under study
This skill provides quick access to key information from [COMPANY]'s documentation website, focusing on [SPECIFIC_TOPIC]. It is designed to streamline operations and reduce the need for manual searches.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/moinulmoin/doc2skill`
sections.usage:
```
Convert the documentation website [WEBSITE_URL] into a Claude AI skill. The documentation is for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Focus on extracting key information about [SPECIFIC_TOPIC], such as setup instructions, troubleshooting tips, and best practices. Ensure the skill is optimized for quick access and easy integration into existing workflows.
```
Copy

```
# Documentation Skill for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] Sector

- "How do I configure [SPECIFIC_TOPIC] for [COMPANY]?"
- "What are the common issues with [SPECIFIC_TOPIC] and how to resolve them?"
- "What are the best practices for using [SPECIFIC_TOPIC] in [INDUSTRY]?"
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
